item.description: I am an assistant professor (senior lecturer) at the Department of Economics at Monash University. My research interests lie at the intersection of Politics, Environment, and Development Economics. It has been published in journals such as the American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, the Review of Economics and Statistics and the Journal of Public Economics. I am a recipient of the Australian Research Council’s Discovery Early Career Researcher Award (ARC DECRA) for the period 2026-2028.

List of current and past students I supervised here. For current and prospective students, RAs, and postdocs: please read this. Supervision Hours (Monash only): Schedule here. Open Door (for anyone): Schedule here.

Email: ricardo.dahis@monash.edu NOTE: For Data Basis-related issues, please contact the project directly, read the documentation and FAQ, or ask the community on Discord! I may not reply to email about it (why?).
Ice Cream Map: Mapping and reviewing ice cream spots worldwide, one at a time.
Upcoming talks: University of Technology Sydney (29 April), UCSD (16 November), SMU (18 November) I was invited to become a J-PAL invited researcher in 2026.
